edits.new:
Given a call to the timeline of case RW-2026-000801 by a user whose role does not include Case record R
    When the timeline is called
    Then the response is 403

  Scenario: AC11 A personal field in a contact summary is masked by role (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a contact item on the timeline of case RW-2026-000801 whose summary holds a personal field
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns the masking policy for the role of U-81
    When the timeline opens
    Then the summary shows the value the masking policy allows for that role
    Then the rest of the item shows with its time and its by

  Scenario: AC12 The type order and the section timeout come from the parameters contract (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the parameters contract returns `timeline.type.order` and `caserecord.section.timeout.ms` on every request
    When the timeline opens
    Then the items follow the type order the parameters contract returned
    Then a source that exceeds the returned section timeout sets its section to the failed state with MSG-P3-023
    Then no order and no timeout is read from a constant in code

  Scenario: AC13 The timeline of a case with 500 events reads in under 2 seconds (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given case RW-2026-000801 has 500 events across the four sources
    Given the rwb-decision, rwb-source-data and rwb-document contract mocks answer within their 2 s budget
    When the timeline opens
    Then the first page is returned in under 2 seconds (NFR-070)

  Scenario: AC14 A transfer item takes its queues from the assignment rows and its rule version from the decision record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a transfer at 2026-12-04 14:00 with an assignment row carrying the to queue and a closed previous assignment row carrying the from queue and the from owner
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the transfer decision record with rule "TRF-007" and version "TRF-2026.11"
    When the transfer item is opened
    Then the to queue comes from `assignment.queue_id`, and the from queue and the from owner from the closed previous assignment row
    Then the rule version "TRF-2026.11" comes from the decision record, never from a column

  Scenario: AC15 A case state change and the creation item come from the decision records (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given case RW-2026-000802 has no status-history row of its own
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the creation record and a state change record of the case
    When the timeline opens
    Then the creation item and the state change show from the decision records, with the rule version

  Scenario: AC16 The scope filter applies before the merge (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given case RW-2026-000804 belongs to team "LIT-BKK" and U-81 has scope Own
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns scope Own for U-81
    Given the rwb-decision, rwb-source-data and rwb-document contract mocks record every call
    When U-81 opens the timeline for RW-2026-000804
    Then the response is 404 with MSG-P4-003 and no item
    Then none of the three contracts is called for the case
